scope.zh: 多来源发现、原帖审核与互动数据更新（部分覆盖）
scope.en: Multi-source discovery, original-source review and metrics (partial coverage)

limitations: Accepted Fable cases are explicitly creator-attributed; backend model identity, routing and any official release were not verified.

Configured endpoints, public catalogs and web/X/video searches are bounded discovery, not an exhaustive internet crawl. Every keyword-matched candidate in the resulting pools was reviewed against its original source; nothing was auto-imported.
X search: 25 requests, 22 succeeded; three chains ended with a 404 on a later page and the three per-day Top chains reached the five-page cap. Top search is not a global popularity ranking.
Scientific validity, performance, costs and generation claims remain author-reported; no independent reproduction. Model roles are separated in multi-tool work.
Historical metrics: X 38/38. Failed requests (mostly deleted or unavailable posts) preserve prior valid values and timestamps. No new reply-thread audit.
